# Phoenix East Aviation

> > Phoenix East Aviation is an FAA-approved flight school offering comprehensive pilot training programs with pathways to airline careers through partnerships with United Airlines and other industry leaders.

Phoenix East Aviation (PEA) is a leading flight training institution based in Daytona Beach, Florida, specializing in both Part 141 and Part 61 pilot certification programs. The school serves US and international students, offering professional pilot training, career pathways, and partnerships with major airlines including United's Aviate program.

## Key Topics

- FAA Pilot Certification
- Part 141 & Part 61 Training
- Professional Pilot Programs
- United Airlines Aviate
- International Student Training
- Airline Career Pathways
- Multi-Engine & Flight Instructor Ratings
- DGCA to FAA License Conversion
- GI Bill VA Benefits
- Daytona Beach Flight School
- Aircraft Fleet Training
- College Partnerships
- M-1 & F-1 Visa Support
- Accelerated Programs
- Student Services & Support

## Core Programs & Courses

- [Aviation and Flight Training Courses](https://pea.com/courses): Overview of FAA-approved Part 141 and Part 61 flight training courses
- [Professional Pilot Training Programs](https://pea.com/courses/professional-programs): Professional pilot programs with multi-engine and flight instructor ratings
- [International Licensing Programs](https://pea.com/courses/international-licensing-programs): DGCA to FAA pilot license conversion and international training programs
- [Class Schedule](https://pea.com/courses/class-schedule): Flight training class schedules and enrollment dates for all courses

## Career Pathways & Partnerships

- [Aviate](https://pea.com/aviate): United Airlines Aviate program: secure pilot pathway with conditional job offer
- [Career Pathways](https://pea.com/career-pathways): United Airlines Aviate partnership and airline career pathway programs
- [Partners](https://pea.com/partners): Airline and industry partnerships including United, Boeing, and JSfirm

## Admissions & Student Information
